combo_label: In the Bathroom × At the Art Gallery × Dinosaurs

entries.clue: The smallest room's centrepiece, plumbed and porcelain
Linseed-bound medium the Old Masters left months to dry
Genre in which the countryside fills the whole view
Brand-new youngster only just chipped free of its shell
Coiled ram's-horn seashell that tumbles from crumbling seaside cliffs
Keeper who decides what hangs where this season
Thigh piece so huge one was once taken for a biblical giant's
Curling ivory plough a shaggy ice-age beast drove through the snowdrifts
Slippery bar that leaps from wet hands like a fish
Tank behind the throne that sighs as it refills
